item.description:
Release v5.14.0

Changes since v5.13.1

  • docs: add commit convention rules
  • docs: add custom LLM providers planning document
  • feat: add llmProvidersDidChange event and ensure valid selection on startup
  • feat: Add Toast plugin and show toast when enabling plugins
  • feat: support custom LLM providers with persistent configuration
  • feat(ActivityBar): add context menu to open settings
  • feat(AppStorePromoDesignerPlugin): add prompt suggestion with activateRailTab action
  • feat(EditorSwiftPlugin): enable Swift editor by default
  • feat(LumiUI): add shared toolbar title label component
  • feat(OcrPlugin): add on-device OCR plugin with agent tool
  • feat(ProjectOverviewPlugin): add project overview prompt suggestion
  • feat(ScreenRecorderPlugin): add screen recorder plugin with agent tools
  • feat(TextActions): add LLM translate action
  • fix: observe conversation selection via ObservableObject to avoid stale state
  • fix: resolve default model in context size view when no explicit selection
  • fix(mind-map): only show toolbar title when Mind Map container is active
  • fix(OnboardingPlugin): bundle Localizable.strings for all locales
  • refactor: introduce providerInfo instance property on LumiLLMProvider
  • refactor(AppIconDesignerPlugin): adopt AppToolbarTitleLabel in toolbar title
  • refactor(AppIconDesignerPlugin): extract railTabID constant and remove unused prompt suggestions
